chunks: 'Ali narrated from his father, from Hammad ibn 'Isa, from Hariz, from Zurarah, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them.
Regarding the slave, when he kills a free man, he is handed over to the heirs of the slain; if they wish, they may kill him, and if they wish, they may enslave him.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءِ: the heirs or legal guardians entitled to act in the case
key_terms.اسْتَرَقُّوهُ: they may enslave him; take him as property
key_terms.الْحُرَّ: the free person; the victim in contrast to a slave
key_terms.الْعَبْدِ: the slave; the perpetrator in this legal case
key_terms.قَتَلُوهُ: they may kill him; carry out retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave kills a free man in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliation when a slave kills a free person. It assigns authority to the heirs of the victim to choose between killing the perpetrator or taking him into enslavement.
